meta.name: convex-quickstart
meta.description: Creates or adds Convex to an app. Use for new Convex projects, npm create convex@latest, frontend setup, env vars, or the first npx convex dev run.

copy.tagline: 快速为应用添加 Convex 后端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用 Convex 做后端但不想从头配置
copy.tagline_en: Quickly add Convex backend to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to use Convex as backend without manual setup

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你创建一个新的 Convex 项目，或者把 Convex 后端添加到已有的应用中。它会自动运行命令行工具来搭建项目、安装依赖、配置环境变量，并验证代码是否正确。
howto.when: 当你想要开始一个新的 Convex 项目，或者给现有的 React、Next.js 等应用添加 Convex 后端时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的 Convex 项目，使用 React + Vite 模板。
给这个已有的 Next.js 应用添加 Convex 后端。
帮我验证 Convex 设置是否正常。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you create a new Convex project or add Convex to an existing app. It automatically runs command-line tools to scaffold the project, install dependencies, set environment variables, and verify the code is correct.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to start a new Convex project or add Convex to an existing React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or other app.

say_en.text: Create a new Convex project using the React + Vite template.
say_en.note: The skill runs npm create convex@latest with the react-vite-shadcn template.

say_en.text: Add Convex to this existing Next.js app.
say_en.note: The skill installs the convex package and configures the Provider and env vars.

say_en.text: Verify the Convex setup is working.
say_en.note: The skill runs npx convex dev --once and checks the output.
